
## Run SCENIC using slurm arrays
```{bash}
human_data=\
  ($(cut -f 3 misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv \
    | sort \
    | uniq \
    | grep -v Sample_ID\
  ))

sbatch \
  --array=0-$((${#human_data[@]}-1)) \
  analysis_modules/10_cmp_other_methods/scripts/array_scevan_human.sh

mouse_data=(
  $(
    {
      cut -f 5 misc/mouse_samples_Roberts_metadata.tsv
      cut -f 5 misc/mouse_samples_Roberts_realign_metadata_human.tsv
    } |
      grep -v '^Sample_ID$' |
      sort -u
  )
)

sbatch \
  --array=0-$((${#mouse_data[@]}-1)) \
  analysis_modules/10_cmp_other_methods/scripts/array_scevan_mouse.sh
```
